name: Blog post to social drafts

parameters.content:
## Blog post → social drafts
Blog post → AI writes 3 channel posts → checks → review queue.

**Guards:** length and link rules per channel · hashtag limits · every number must be in the blog post · absolute claims (guaranteed, 100%, best, proven…) are flagged in the post and in the source · nothing is ever published automatically.

**AI off:** template posts.

description: Turns a published blog post into LinkedIn, Instagram and X drafts, checks each against channel rules, invented numbers and risky claims, and puts them in a review queue. Never posts anything.
